audit.description: Run a full multi-agent code audit across all dimensions
audit.template: Run a comprehensive multi-agent code audit of this project. Use the audit-coordinator subagent to orchestrate all specialized auditors (sec-auditor, arch-auditor, perf-auditor, quality-auditor, deps-auditor, tier-auditor). Produce a unified audit report with severity ratings (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INFO), detailed findings per category, and actionable remediation steps.

audit:security.description: Run only the security audit agent
audit:security.template: Run a security-focused code audit using the sec-auditor subagent. Scan for secrets exposure, auth flaws, injection risks, XSS, dependency CVEs, and Fortress bypass vectors.

audit:arch.description: Run only the architecture audit agent
audit:arch.template: Run an architecture-focused code audit using the arch-auditor subagent. Analyze coupling, layer violations, circular dependencies, modular monolith adherence, and design pattern usage.

audit:performance.description: Run only the performance audit agent
audit:performance.template: Run a performance-focused code audit using the perf-auditor subagent. Identify N+1 queries, memory leaks, re-render issues, bundle bloat, and media pipeline bottlenecks.

audit:quality.description: Run only the code quality audit agent
audit:quality.template: Run a code quality audit using the quality-auditor subagent. Check conventions, code duplication, error handling, logging, test coverage, and file organization.

audit:deps.description: Run only the dependency audit agent
audit:deps.template: Run a dependency audit using the deps-auditor subagent. Check for CVEs, outdated packages, license compliance, deprecated dependencies, and peer conflicts across npm, NuGet, and pip.

audit:tier.description: Run only the license tier enforcement audit agent
audit:tier.template: Run a license tier enforcement audit using the tier-auditor subagent. Validate Fortress integrity checks, tier gating logic, license server communication, and installer tier separation.

impl.description: Run a multi-domain implementation task with the dev-coordinator
impl.template: Implement the requested feature or fix using the dev-coordinator subagent. Break the work into domain-specific tasks and delegate to the appropriate writer agents (react-writer, csharp-writer, html-writer, python-writer, shell-writer, docker-writer, electron-writer, test-writer). Integrate results and verify with tests.

impl:react.template: Implement the requested React frontend changes using the react-writer subagent. Follow project patterns: Radix UI primitives, Tailwind CSS, functional components with hooks, React.lazy for code splitting, and React Testing Library tests.

impl:csharp.template: Implement the requested C# backend changes using the csharp-writer subagent. Follow project patterns: controllers delegate to services, EF Core with SQLite, BCrypt auth, JWT, Fortress integration, and xUnit tests.

impl:html.template: Implement the requested HTML/CSS changes using the html-writer subagent. Follow Tailwind CSS conventions, ensure responsive design, accessibility (ARIA), and dark mode compatibility.

impl:python.template: Implement the requested Python changes using the python-writer subagent. Follow FastAPI async patterns, httpx for HTTP calls, and pytest for tests.

impl:shell.template: Implement the requested shell script or CI/CD changes using the shell-writer subagent. Follow bash/fish best practices: error handling with set -e, idempotent operations, and clear logging.

impl:docker.template: Implement the requested Docker changes using the docker-writer subagent. Follow multi-stage build patterns, minimize layer size, handle build args for tier selection.

impl:electron.template: Implement the requested Electron changes using the electron-writer subagent. Follow security best practices (contextIsolation, nodeIntegration disabled), configure auto-updater, and handle native OS integration.

impl:test.description: Write or fix tests across the project
impl:test.template: Implement the requested test changes using the test-writer subagent. Create comprehensive tests following project patterns: xUnit for C#, React Testing Library for JSX, pytest for Python. Aim for meaningful coverage.

qa.description: Run a full QA test pass across all dimensions using the qa-coordinator
qa.template: Run a comprehensive QA test pass using the qa-coordinator subagent. Include all specialized QA agents (qa-unit, qa-integration, qa-e2e, qa-accessibility, qa-regression, qa-load, qa-security, qa-tier). Produce a unified QA report with pass/fail status per dimension.

qa:unit.template: Run unit tests across all layers using the qa-unit subagent. Execute C# xUnit, React Jest/RTL, and Python pytest suites. Report pass/fail results and coverage.

qa:integration.template: Run integration tests using the qa-integration subagent. Test API contracts, database operations, service integration, and module loading.

qa:e2e.template: Run end-to-end tests using the qa-e2e subagent. Execute Playwright/Cypress tests or manually verify critical user flows (login, browse, playback, settings).

qa:a11y.template: Run accessibility tests using the qa-accessibility subagent. Audit WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for all key pages.

qa:regression.template: Run regression tests using the qa-regression subagent. Verify existing features still work, run smoke tests on critical paths.

qa:load.template: Run load and performance tests using the qa-load subagent. Benchmark API response times, analyze bundle size, check memory usage.

qa:security.template: Run security tests using the qa-security subagent. Probe for auth bypass, injection, XSS, CVE vulnerabilities, and Fortress weaknesses.

qa:tier.template: Run tier and license enforcement tests using the qa-tier subagent. Validate tier separation, Fortress integrity, license flow, and installer correctness.

audit-coordinator.description: Orchestrates multi-dimensional code audits by delegating to specialized auditors and synthesizing results into a unified report

sec-auditor.description: Security audit specialist: secrets, auth, injection, XSS, CVEs, Fortress bypass

arch-auditor.description: Architecture audit specialist: coupling, layers, circular deps, modular monolith patterns

perf-auditor.description: Performance audit specialist: N+1 queries, memory, re-renders, bundle size, async patterns

quality-auditor.description: Code quality audit specialist: conventions, duplication, error handling, testing, logging

deps-auditor.description: Dependency audit specialist: CVEs, outdated packages, licenses, deprecation, peer conflicts

tier-auditor.description: Tier enforcement audit specialist: Fortress integrity, tier gating, license validation, installer separation

dev-coordinator.description: Orchestrates multi-domain implementation tasks by delegating to domain-specific writer agents and integrating results

csharp-writer.description: C#/.NET 10 backend specialist: controllers, services, EF Core, DI, auth, Fortress, tier gating, xUnit tests

electron-writer.description: Electron specialist: desktop config, native APIs, auto-update, security hardening, OS integration

test-writer.description: Cross-domain testing specialist: xUnit, Moq, Jest, RTL, Playwright, pytest, integration tests
